jobs.notes: Scheme page lists key dates as day-and-month only (open Wed 9 June, close Sun 4 or Sun 11 July, offers Wed 8 September) without an explicit year in the text retrieved, so the year could not be confirmed; eligibility is penultimate-year students and the 2026 cycle (10 June – 12 July 2026) has already closed.
